error_codes.-32603: Internal error; sanitized custom-handler failure with data.error_id

error_semantics.custom_root: Custom method exceptions (unknown method, invalid/missing parameters, unexpected failures) return -32603 Internal error with data.error_id. Typed -32601/-32602 mapping is deferred.
error_semantics.message_send: Handler exceptions inside message/send become sanitized error text in the agent reply, not a JSON-RPC error envelope.
error_semantics.built_in_routes: Task routing has separate behavior; this contract does not promise custom-handler -32601/-32602 or domain-specific codes.
